summary: Builtin workflow definition content changes carry a new version: the authored definitions are Version 2 and the registry compiles the released Version-1 definitions, so a pin on any shipped version verifies forever. The pins CD-0112 orphaned re-pin once through a fold-guard migration that moves a row to its ref's Version-2 digest only when the row matches no shipped population and its current step is a Version-2 step; an unplaceable row stays refused by name. A shipped digest fixture pins every registry digest to the migration's literals, so content changing without a version bump fails the test.
title: Workflow definitions carry shipped versions and orphaned pins re-pin
